knobs.note: Days bin/alerts-groom.sh keeps flags/alerted-*-YYYYMMDD and the dated box flags degraded-<box>-YYYYMMDD, authprobe-inconclusive-<box>-YYYYMMDD and lane-caps-degraded-<lane>-YYYYMMDD-<cksum> (dated by its middle segment), by the date in the name. Code fallback ${ALERT_FLAG_RETENTION_DAYS-7} (7 when unset); below 2 or not a whole number the groom refuses and deletes nothing, so today's and yesterday's flag always survive.

BH-2526: newest kind=migration jobs per project whose stage_events rule 2 of bin/alerts-groom.sh reads for an APPLIED PR#n. Code fallback ${ALERTS_GROOM_MIGRATION_JOBS:-20}; not a whole number >= 1 holds the row as unknown.

BH-4056: how old pipeline-health's state/health-active.stamp (written after a COMPLETE pass) may be before the ph-absent pass of bin/alerts-supersede.py and bin/alerts-hygiene-ph-backlog.sh resolve anything from health-active.txt. Code fallback 30 when unset; not a whole number >= 1 holds the pass, never clamps.
